Ten comments

The taylor’s twist

Source: Tommy Peoples_ “Master Irish Fiddle Player”. Transcription: Gian Marco Pietrasanta

↳ Posted by gian marco on September 27th, 2002.

I had a Tommy People’s instructional book once upon a time. I learned this hornpipe from there. Since then - I lost the tune. Thanks for the refresher!

This is a great hornpipe especially when those trio’s are single bowed.

↳ Posted by Mark Cordova on September 30th, 2002.

The Tailor’s Twist

This tune is also played by Liam O’Flynn on Planxty’s “The Woman I Loved so Well”.

↳ Posted by Jigfoot on September 15th, 2007.

A tin whistle version here

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeRzEdO2R4A

↳ Posted by fluther on August 1st, 2015.

The Tailor’s Twist, X:3

Piper’s version

↳ Posted by swisspiper on January 27th, 2017.

The Tailor’s Twist, X:4

This is one of those hornpipes that you hear now and again in sessions, like it, and promise yourself you’ll learn it… Taken from ‘A Fine Selection of Over 200 Irish Traditional Tunes for Sessions’, compiled by David Speers with a Forward by Matt Cranitch. It was collected with the title The Tailor’s Thimble.

↳ Posted by Eubonian on January 25th, 2019.

Re: The Tailor’s Twist/The Jolly Butchers

I learned the Tailor’s Twist a few years ago. It’s a lovely hornpipe. Yesterday in my ancient original Kerr’s Collection of the Popular Tunes of All Nations I discovered the hornpipe in the collection as The Jolly Butchers, perhaps the original name. The only tiny difference is the 2nd bar of the B part resolves in d instead of a.

↳ Posted by jamadairg on May 8th, 2020.

The Tailor’s Twist, X:5

A slightly different version as played by Eliot Grasso (at least his first time through the tune). He plays some nice variations on the tune repeats.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T3QGlauE9U0

↳ Posted by BagpiperTom on June 2nd, 2021.

Re: The Tailor’s Twist

I picked this up from Brian Hughes’s album “This Day 20 Years” following Fly By Night in a set. It is a really nice whistle tune which will test your fingering skills.
